title: Senior API Designer / API Architect
description: Senior API designer and platform architect responsible for organization-wide API style guide authorship, schema evolution governance, GraphQL federation architecture, Zero Trust API security, capacity planning, regulatory compliance, and API-as-a-Product program management.

skills.rationale: Designing API usage analytics frameworks, ensuring regulatory compliance (PSD2, GDPR, HIPAA), and managing API-as-a-Product strategy with monetization and partner programs.
Authoring and enforcing organization-wide API style guides, defining schema evolution compatibility rules, and designing hypermedia affordance patterns.
Architecting GraphQL federation and subgraph ownership, operating schema registries with compatibility governance, and designing streaming API patterns.
Conducting OWASP API Security Top 10 threat modeling, architecting Zero Trust API platforms, and designing organization-wide API abuse prevention systems.
Architecting multi-gateway topologies, designing service mesh traffic management, and building automated backward compatibility verification pipelines.
Architecting CDN edge distribution, conducting API capacity planning with traffic forecasting, and designing platform-wide throttling and backpressure policies.
Architecting organization-wide CORS policy frameworks and planning HTTP/2 to HTTP/3 protocol evolution strategies across the API platform.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in API governance, style guide authorship, or platform architecture.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Solid mid-level API design, but lacks experience in federation architecture, API program management, and regulatory compliance.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong technical capabilities across most API design areas; refining expertise in hypermedia, Zero Trust, and capacity planning.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all senior expectations: authors style guides, governs API programs, architects federation and gateway topologies, and ensures compliance.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds senior expectations: staff/principal-level impact across enterprise API platforms with industry-recognized API program leadership.
